findings.title: Audio stop failure prevents cloud session cleanup
findings.why_it_matters: When the board output device fails while stopping, close exits before closing the WebSocket or clearing queued microphone data and tool results. ConversationPaths._stop has already removed the session reference, and closed=True suppresses later cleanup attempts, leaving the cloud connection unclosed and aborting route switching/privacy/shutdown cleanup.
findings.suggested_fix: Run audio stop/player close and WebSocket close/queue erasure in nested try/finally blocks so every cleanup stage runs even if the sound device fails; propagate the original audio error after cleanup. Add a fake-player stop failure regression asserting socket closure and sensitive buffer clearing.
evidence: device/lira/audio/doubao_realtime.py:238-240: await self._stop_output(); await self.player.close(); if self.ws is not None:
device/lira/audio/doubao_realtime.py:231-233: if self.closed: return; self.closed = True (cleanup cannot subsequently be retried).
device/lira/audio/doubao_realtime.py:126: await self.player.stop() is executed by _stop_output; device/lira/hal/board/audio.py:_abort_blocking explicitly raises HalError on PortAudio abort failure.
device/lira/conversation_paths.py:191-196 removes self.session before awaiting session.close(), so the failing session is no longer available to subsequent stop calls.

residual_risks: No live cloud credentials or cloud session exercised. External protocol, voice/model acceptance, server tool-turn sequencing and interruption semantics require an actual endpoint test.
Security, reliability and adversarial passes shared the same reviewer context and are not independent confirmations.

No credential files or process environment were read. Key handling inspected in source only: repr=False, fixed TLS endpoint/header, snapshot presence flags and sanitized startup errors; no new exploitable credential disclosure established.
Static text search only; dynamic callbacks may add other call paths. Review limited to explicitly delegated route changes; pre-existing Jev implementation and other WIP excluded.
testing_gaps: No cancellation regression at await session.open() or chime.wait(): ConversationPaths.start only catches Exception, so CancelledError after creation may bypass owner cleanup; add cancellation injection checks before treating request cancellation as safe.

Existing protocol mock confirms client-authored event shapes rather than independent server compatibility. Live tests must verify tool acknowledgement then immediate handoff/close does not lose the action.
Exercise elderly long utterances and long assistant audio against the 60-second text-only idle clock; no activity refresh occurs on input PCM or streamed output.
